edition: GitHub REST API, X-GitHub-Api-Version 2022-11-28, api.github.com (GitHub.com; GHES untested)

operations.name: sync_page
operations.description: workflow_run (created>= date filter + exact updated_at watermark), workflow_job and artifact per run (resource_id owner/name#<run_id>)

operations.name: fetch_document
operations.description: Run logs (owner/name#run:<id>): follows the single redirect to an allowlisted storage origin without the API token, inspects the zip, returns redacted text

limitations: Dispatch and rerun are not implemented (no ReviewedAction); the shared transport refuses bare mutations
Artifact download is not implemented (only metadata incl. expiry); logs beyond retention return 410 which maps to DataError('expired')
The `created` run filter is date-granular; exact filtering by updated_at happens client-side with the overlap window
Log storage origin was observed live on 2026-10-16 (results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com) and may change; it is configurable
Official documentation was not retrievable from the build session (ADR-0004); live verification used gateway-injected credentials
